assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: GRRIND hand-painted 3D character reference board, latest "Style peint main" section of brief.md.
Primary request:
Two full-body views (three-quarter front, and three-quarter back) of the same original young
adult athlete character for a mobile 3D tactics game, rendered as a real-time 3D game model with
hand-painted textures: stylized low-poly forms with clean simple planes, chunky proportions about
3.5 heads tall, large head, oversized mitten-like hands, big boots-like feet, short legs, broad
shoulders. Soft painted lighting from above, painted ambient occlusion in creases, soft warm
highlights, almost no outlines, no coloured rim light, no gloss. Simple sporty outfit with clear
colour blocks: grey sleeveless training top with an orange trim, navy shorts with ivory side
stripes, wrist bands, chunky navy and cream sneakers. Short dark brown hair in a few big sculpted
locks, friendly confident face with large expressive eyes. Plain white background, soft round
contact shadow under each figure. No text, no logo, no realistic anatomy or muscle striation.
Composition: front three-quarter on the left, rear three-quarter on the right, same scale, same outfit, same proportions and same individual in both views. Entire hair, hands and shoes visible with ample margin. One character identity, two views only.
Style precision: original design with the broad hand-painted low-poly game-art sensibility of Waven, without reproducing any existing character. Visible broad brush-shaped color planes and painted warm highlights, economical angular geometry, matte diffuse hand-painted texture. Head from crown to chin should occupy about 29 percent of full standing height, for a total of about 3.5 heads. Short stout legs and enormous blocky empty fists. Adult athlete, no baby face. No realistic deltoid/biceps anatomy, no veins, no skin pores, no fabric weave or fine folds, no glossy Pixar-like smooth plastic shading, no cyan accents. Do not turn this into a 2D illustration; it should look like a hand-painted textured low-poly 3D game model.
assets.role: Two views of same hand-painted low-poly athlete, three-quarter front and rear

references.role: Direct identity, proportions, costume, style reference

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: GRRIND single-subject T-pose input for image-to-3D, latest hand-painted brief.
Input image 1 role: exact CHARACTER IDENTITY, PROPORTIONS, COSTUME and HAND-PAINTED STYLE reference. Use the front-facing figure on the left as the identity anchor, and the rear view only as costume context.
Primary request:
The same character from the reference image, front view, strict symmetrical T-pose, arms
horizontal, both hands closed into big empty fists holding nothing, legs slightly apart, full
body from hair to shoes, same hand-painted 3D game model rendering and soft top lighting, no
rim light, flat plain light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text, single character.
Preserve his exact face, large eyes, brown sculpted hair locks, warm tan skin, grey sleeveless training top with orange neckline and armhole trim, navy shorts with ivory side stripes, navy wristbands and chunky navy/cream sneakers with the small orange heel insert. Preserve chunky very compact proportions from the concept: about 3.3 to 3.5 heads tall, head including hair through neck about 29 to 30 percent of full standing height, short legs, broad shoulders and enormous closed empty mitten-like fists. Do not elongate the body for T-pose.
Direct orthographic frontal camera, left-right symmetric placement, both shoulders level, upper arms and forearms straight in one horizontal line at shoulder height, hands in CLOSED fists with folded fingers and thumbs resting across them. Nothing held; no handles, cylinders, objects or openings in fists. Both shoes pointing forward, legs slightly apart. Entire figure and fists inside the image, generous padding on all sides. One subject, no contact shadow, no gradient background, no multiview or duplicate. Hand-painted broad warm light/shadow patches on simple low-poly surfaces, angular clean planes and minimal outlines, no gloss, no realistic anatomy or muscle striation, no skin pores, no cloth weave, no colored rim lighting. Match the actual reference rather than restyling it.
CRITICAL PROPORTION REQUIREMENT: make this a distinctly more compact athlete, EXACTLY 3.4 heads tall, not 3.7 or 4. The whole head INCLUDING HAIR from crown to bottom of chin occupies a full 30 percent of the character's standing height. Increase the head size relative to torso and legs by about 12 percent compared to a normal compact hero; make torso shorter and legs very stubby. Shoulder-to-sole distance is only about 2.4 head heights. Keep an adult confident face, not infant proportions. Prioritize these measured short proportions while matching the reference's character identity, colors, hairstyle, hand-painted texture and outfit. Recenter the complete compact figure with generous white-grey margins so hair and shoes stay well inside frame. Closed fists, strict horizontal T-pose, no shadow.
assets.role: Single frontal T-pose, empty closed fists, sneakers

review.visual: Inspected both images as generated at full displayed resolution. Full figures, matched outfit colors and identity, painted low-poly planes and no colored rim light. T-pose: one frontal subject, complete hair/fists/shoes, horizontal arms, closed empty fists, plain grey background and no floor shadow.

measurement.note: Heuristic crown-to-neck silhouette measurement; does not imply artistic approval.
